components.name: button
apiTransformations: Canonical isLoading with deprecated isPending alias; loading disables actions and exposes busy state.
behaviorDeviations: Native accessibility disabled and busy flags always reflect the shared computed state, including disabled without loading.
Primary mousedown/mouseup are isolated at the web root when Pointer Events are supported; custom callbacks run and the legacy document mouse fallback is preserved.
stylingDeviations: Web retains the original React slot classes and complete pinned React CSS; native retains Native semantic component styles.

components.name: pressable-feedback
apiTransformations: Shared root and Scale, Highlight, and Ripple parts; boolean and disabled animation controls; typed platform extensions and platform-specific refs.
behaviorDeviations: Web uses React Aria Button with pointer-origin, size-aware Web Animations API ripples, centered for keyboard and virtual presses, with independent expansion and opacity tracks and overlapping surfaces; native retains the owned touch-origin Reanimated ripple. Native asChild and granular animation configuration are not shared.
Primary mousedown/mouseup are isolated at the web root when Pointer Events are supported; custom callbacks run and the legacy document mouse fallback is preserved.
stylingDeviations: Browser interaction selectors live in styles/web-only.css; native retains the owned animation implementation.
